title: WinUI Gallery catalog manifest
description: Machine-readable inventory of the embedded samples in this repository, generated by tools/CatalogExporter from WinUIGallery/SampleSupport/Data/ControlInfoData.json and the WinUIGallery/Samples/<UniqueId>/ folders. Intended to be imported into a federated windows-samples catalog (catalog/samples.json). See catalog/README.md for the full contract and regeneration instructions.

$schema.description: Relative path back to this schema file.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this manifest's contract, bumped whenever a breaking change is made to the shape below.

command.description: Command used to regenerate this file.

repository.description: Provenance of every sample in this file. Deliberately does not pin a commit SHA - this manifest describes the current state of the default branch and is regenerated whenever samples change.

defaults.description: Facts shared by every sample in this repository so they are not repeated on each entry (all samples in this repository are embedded C# WinUI 3 / Windows App SDK gallery pages under the MIT license).

kind.description: Sample kind shared by every entry: an embedded page inside the single WinUI Gallery app, not a standalone project.

sampleCount.description: Number of entries in 'samples'. Kept alongside the array for cheap consumer-side sanity checks.

id.description: Source-qualified, collision-safe id: '{owner}/{repo}#{uniqueId}'. Stable across regenerations as long as uniqueId does not change.

uniqueId.description: Original WinUI Gallery UniqueId from ControlInfoData.json. Matches the WinUIGallery/Samples/<uniqueId>/ folder name exactly.

tags.description: Search keywords carried over from ControlInfoData.json's Tags.

aliases.description: Catalog-only extra keywords from an item's optional Catalog.Aliases override.

relatedSamples.description: Ids of conceptually related samples, combining ControlInfoData.json's RelatedControls (resolved to this repository) with any cross-repository Catalog.RelatedSamples override. Same-repository references are validated to resolve to another entry in 'samples'.

source.description: Repository-relative locations for this sample's source, rooted at the repository root (not pinned to a commit).

page.description: Main XAML page for this sample.

codeBehind.description: Code-behind file for the main page, when present.

snippets.description: All *.txt code snippet files displayed in the gallery UI for this sample.

scenarios.description: Interactive scenarios within the page, one per controls:ControlExample element that declares a SampleDefinition snippet.

snippet.description: File name of the snippet, relative to 'source.root'.
